tier_definitions.official-league: Published by the National Football League on nfl.com. The league is the governing body and its injury report is the official availability document.
tier_definitions.official-club: Published by a member club on that club's own domain. Officially operated by the club, but the clubs themselves label these charts unofficial, and most print no as-of date. Recorded at this tier so the distinction is visible rather than hidden.

note: The shared repository auditor verify/source_audit.py keeps an OFFICIAL_HOSTS allow-list that does not include member-club domains, so it classifies club-published rows as 'dataset'. This session did not edit that shared allow-list; the club tier is recorded here instead, and the disagreement is logged as an open governance question on the flagged page.
